北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云炎热，注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hot and sunny, remember to hydrate and protect from sun!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿热，小心暑气，记得多喝水！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is muggy, beware of heatstroke, drink more water!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨湿哒哒，出门记得带伞，小心潮湿哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is rainy and humid, take an umbrella and watch out for dampness.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云风大，出门注意防晒，小心阵风。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and windy, protect from sun and watch out for gusts.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好风大，注意防晒和补水，谨防中暑！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and windy, stay hydrated and protected from sun, avoid heatstroke!
深圳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨湿热，记得带伞，注意防潮和防暑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is rainy and humid, take an umbrella and stay cool.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微热，风力稍大，出门注意防风防暑。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and warm with some wind, be mindful of wind and heat.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云有风，体感舒适，记得添衣别着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and windy, feels pleasant, layer up to avoid catching a cold.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降9℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨湿度高，记得带伞，注意防潮防闷热。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is rainy and very humid, take an umbrella and stay cool.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安小雨湿热，出门记得带伞，小心路滑哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is rainy and humid, take an umbrella and watch out for slippery roads.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿润，体感舒适，出门带把伞备用。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and humid, feels comfortable, bring an umbrella just in case.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨中雨风大，出门带好雨具，注意保暖防着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has moderate rain and strong winds, bring rain gear and stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云舒适，微风习习，出门记得带件外套。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and comfortable, with a gentle breeze, bring a jacket.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天湿冷，体感凉爽，记得添衣保暖哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, humid and cool, remember to dress warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云闷热，湿度较大，记得补水防中暑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and muggy, very humid, remember to hydrate and avoid heatstroke.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾弥漫，能见度低，开车注意安全哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, visibility is low, drive safely.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云舒适，湿度稍高，记得带件外套哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and comfortable, slightly humid, remember to bring a jacket.
